# sherpa-line-chart

A line/area chart over a numeric series.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | chart |
| Figma | Data Field |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-line-chart/sherpa-line-chart.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-line-chart/sherpa-line-chart.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-line-chart/sherpa-line-chart.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-line-chart/sherpa-line-chart.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-line-chart/sherpa-line-chart.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-container><sherpa-data-viz-header slot="header" data-heading="Alerts over time"></sherpa-data-viz-header><sherpa-line-chart data-type="area"></sherpa-line-chart></sherpa-container>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-line-chart`:

```json
{
  "labels": [
    "Mon",
    "Tue",
    "Wed",
    "Thu"
  ],
  "series": [
    {
      "name": "Critical",
      "values": [
        3,
        5,
        2,
        6
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "Warning",
      "values": [
        8,
        6,
        9,
        4
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-aggregate` | `count` `sum` `mean` `min` `max` `distinct` | `count` | count \| sum \| mean \| min \| max \| distinct, per point |
| `data-axis-label` | text |  | y-axis caption (shown when set) |
| `data-bands` | text |  |  |
| `data-bucket` | `day` `month` `year` |  | a date over-field, cut to day \| month \| year |
| `data-field` | text |  | the number that aggregate reads |
| `data-legend` | `horizontal` `vertical` |  |  |
| `data-max` | number |  | y-scale bounds (else derived) |
| `data-min` | number |  | y-scale bounds (else derived) |
| `data-over-field` | text |  | ASKED of its provider: the x axis runs over this field |
| `data-segment-field` | text |  | one line per value of this field |
| `data-ticks` | number | `4` | number of y gridlines/values |
| `data-type` | `line` `area` | `line` | line \| area |
| `data-where` | text |  |  |
| `data-x-axis-label` | text |  | x-axis caption (shown when set) |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `heading` | text | heading above the chart |
| `legend` | legend | a &lt;[sherpa-chart-legend](sherpa-chart-legend.md)> for the series. |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`axis-label`, `figure`, `header`, `hotspots`, `plot`, `svg`, `x-axis`, `x-axis-label`, `y-axis`
